notes.title: [Important] All saves will be reset after the October 10 update.(modified)
notes.content:
The next update is scheduled for October 10th.

After the update, due to changes in the game system, existing save files will become incompatible.

If you have any gameplay progress, it is recommended to finish it before the update.


(Additional) The update is currently being delayed to stabilize the game. The update will be done in a few days.

notes.title: Content to be added in the next big update
notes.content:
[h2][b]New Story[/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40219518/cbfb840c08f668832e71c79aa57327eed6b36454.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40219518/451d0549fc29df461d49aac81deb8abcf1349b24.png[/img]

The final slot of the Princess’ Room that wasn’t active will become usable.
With a new storyline, new heroes and bosses will be added.


[h2][b]Artifacts[/b][/h2]

Artifacts will be added in order to provide more diversity to the gameplay.
Unlike ordinary items, Artifacts have unique abilities of their own.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40219518/a8eff73016ebcdd0dc73b8177b5fc21a85b87dcf.png[/img]
[b]Space-Time Clock[/b]: Upon use, will move the time on the clock 30 seconds back.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40219518/d387531ab330c7987663dac2b5ffa65c0c4f3682.png[/img]
[b]Loan Agreement Form[/b]: When heroes using the village and are run out of money, the will have to take a loan and pay the money back.


How to get Artifacts :
[olist]
[*] Players are given Artifacts by default on the 15th and 30th days.
[*] You can gain better Artifacts by clearing a dungeon safely!
[/olist]


[h2][b]Town[/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40219518/966750b58d9bfc8255bc42001353ff42fabc85e0.png[/img]

Additional facilities have been added that can be placed in the village.
All facilities cannot be placed at once, but the player can decide which facilities that will be placed in the village.
To free up space, Magrandes modified the design of the facility.

Asides from the above, further elements are planned to be added.

※   The information above is currently in development, and can differ from the final update

notes.title: Devil, It's me Update 1.04.1 08/22/2021
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Warning message for maintenance fee has been added. A warning message will be displayed 30 seconds before maintenance fee is deducted.
[*] Keyboard settings option has been added.
[*] [u]Difficulty settings added. All pre-existing games will automatically be adjusted to Normal difficulty.[/u]
[*] Corrupted heroes can now be positioned to be used as bosses.
[*] You can use potions on corrupted heroes.
[*] Reputation for the Tavern will be sustained for longer periods of time.
[/list]

notes.title: Devil, It's me Update 1.03.1 08/13/2021
notes.content:
[list]
[*] The price and maintenance fee of Parasites has been increased.
[*] The price and Health of Lizards have been increased.
[*] Damage dealt by Bombs has been increased.
[*] The Health of Sphere of Tongue has been increased.
[*] Poison damage by Alchemists has been decreased.
[*] Attack speed of King Slimes has been decreased while Health has been increased.
[*] [u]Mental Attack of all monsters has been increased.[/u]

[*] Enemy spawn rate of the Prince after finishing the quest 'Ancient Power' has been reduced.
[*] [u]Upon finishing the quest 'Ancient Power', Magrandes’ health will be fully healed and the energy accumulated by the prince will be adjusted to 0.[/u]

[*] More unique enemies will be spawned while a hidden quest is ongoing.
[*] The difficulty of enemy boss monsters of hidden quest has been increased.
[*] [u]Maintenance fees will be reduced to 0 upon the appearance of the final boss.[/u]
[*] [u]Health has been greatly increased for the final boss of hidden quest.[/u]

[*] [u]Base Health of Magrandes has been increased.[/u]
[*] [u]Items given to Magrandes will only affect half of its performance.[/u]

[*] [u]Autosave can be turned on/off from the item purchasing menu when a day begins.[/u]
[*] Bug fixes.
[/list]

[b]I'll get feedback on what UI needs to be improved before I make any UI patches in the future. I would appreciate it if you could leave a comment about any inconveniences while playing the game.[/b]

notes.title: Demo Major Update 6/1/2021
notes.content:
A major change has been applied to the game under development. The demo version has been updated accordingly.
[list]
[*] Major UI changes have been implemented
[*] A Corruption skill has been added. You can easily corrupt heroes with low HP.
[*] The maximum number of days playable has been adjusted to 14 days.
[*] Main quest line has been added
[*] An ‘Auto Sell’ function has been added. You can set items to be sold automatically by right clicking on its icon
[*] Bug fixes and improvements  
[/list]

notes.title: Demo Update 4/14/2021
notes.content:
Small changes to the game system made changes to the demo as well. This update went with some bug fixes.

- 'Water' no longer exists in the item pool. As a result, the recipe for food has been simplified.

- Several messages have been added to help players play the game.
